translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Yesuŋo Samaria Matko Ŋine Ŋerep Mane Don Olatke
Parisi eŋe Yesu wane iwa yale detkoi, “Eŋe dokoine zok loutne ebuki paki doku tau ongi Yohane wane magu yuanonmami.”
Iwa, Yesu oŋom ŋei mane doku mi taukake. Dokoine edoka weku tauongoi.
Yesu eŋe Parisi don rakoi, yewa detki paki, Yuda qelige more koso Galili kepeo zinge arike.
Eŋe numaine ari more Samaria kepeo lotkeake.
Eŋe ariki paki Samaria wane matine suaine mane, eŋetne Sikar, yewa lotkeke. Mat yewa yemo mo sogino Yakopŋo gipole Yosep kepe mane mange, yewa wane osino pamaike.
Yakop wane doku lom mane eŋe yewa okoramaike. Yesu eŋe numa arikane zonomine midaki, doku lom meuno pese ket metke, kepe deine mo oŋa bango metki, naso yewao.
Samaria ŋerep maneŋo doku osiakane sarike, paki mo Yesuŋo olale rake, “Doku mane ninnom newe.”
Yesu dokoine eŋe ŋara qolekei wane matko ariu, Yesu eŋineka mere ŋerep yewa doku wane qesonkake.

Ŋerepŋo olale rake, “Ge Yuda ŋei, ŋo na Samaria ŋerep, daleo wane noŋo doku ginbe nekenane nolatmaine?” Yuda ŋei so Samaria ŋei eŋe lase pelet wane titiine okane lase weku oka mi ne okane gekoi, ea wane ŋerep eŋe yalewa ra Yesu olatke.

Raki mo Yesuŋo mainge olatke, “Ge siluŋ Anutuŋo onokaka kine kine manerop wawaine gin okanmaike, so ŋei iwa maŋo doku mannom neakane golatmaike, yewa detkene ra, yemo ge maine doku wane qeson kanom, mo eŋe doku gege togoninerop maine gingi nenom rap.”
Raki mo ŋerepŋo olatke, “Suaine, ge lase ŋone midaka, ŋo doku lom yemo kiroroine, ŋo gege togon doku wamo dia ŋine osikene?
Ŋenane qerakze Yakopŋo doku lom iwa ŋebonge, eŋine so gipolekoune, so lama bulamakau koune eŋe korop doku iwa ŋine ne gekoi. Goŋo Yakop wane rokop maine yuankaikene me?”
Yesuŋo mainge olatke, “Mane eŋe doku iwa neake, eŋe baŋ koso doku wane manerop seukeake.

Ŋo mane eŋe doku ea noŋo baŋ manbe neake, eŋe baŋ ŋado koso doku wane manerop mi seukeake, Midakaka. Doku ea noŋo baŋ ŋei mane manikale yewaŋo kotino gege wane doku deine malotke maniake, so gege togon maniake.”
Yale olatki mo ŋerepŋo rake, “Suaine, doku yewa ninnom! Paki na koso doku wane manerop mi seukkale, me doku osikalane iwa koso mi sari okanikale.”
Raki Yesuŋo olatke, “Ari ŋaoŋone olatnom paki mo koso iwa zinge sarinom.”
Ŋerepŋo rake, “Na ŋaone midaine.” Yesuŋo mainge olatke, “Ge ŋaoŋone midaine ramaine, eamo welekatne ramaine.
Ge ŋaokopŋone mete mane 5 ebukone, so ŋeiwa mane eŋerop ukude gemamik, eamo welekatne geŋane ŋaoŋone me mida. Ge don welekatne nolaline.”
Ŋerepŋo rake, “Suaine, na mo detmaile, ge propet.
Naŋane esep milop kopne Samaria ŋei eŋe bonaga iwao Anutu meŋenka okangoi, ŋo Yuda ŋei ŋido wa mo ramami, ŋene Yerusalem matko yewaoka Anutu meŋenka okanikene.”
Yesuŋo ŋerep olale rake, “Ŋerep, ge naŋane don iwa dere malip kanom. Naso mane pamaike yewa bomileki ŋei eŋe bonaga iwao me Yerusalem matko Anutu Magak mi meŋenkakei.
Samaria ŋei ŋine ma meŋenka okanmami, eamo mi detlukmami. Ŋo Yuda ŋei yemo detlukka more meŋenka okanmaine. Onoka wane Anutuŋo ŋei ŋerep ma menaŋ oniakane numa yemo Yuda ŋei ŋenano sarike.

Ŋo naso mane baŋ sariake, yemo mo iwa bomilemaike, yewao ŋei ŋerep meŋe meŋen gorop gemami, eŋe baŋ Magak wele meŋenka lukkei paki, eŋe weteneŋo Asu wane zonomgo so don welekatne, ea wane rokopko Magak baŋ meŋenkaikei. Meŋe meŋen korop yewa ŋei ŋerep yaline edo Magak meŋenkakei wane eŋe ra okanmaike.
Anutu eŋe Asu, ea wane meŋenkaikei wane raso, ŋei ŋerep yewa eŋe weteneŋo Asu wane zonom weneŋ don welekatne ea wane rokopko okan okan me masi mayakatne okane more meŋenkakei.”
Ŋerepŋo Yesu olale rake, “Na detmaile, Mesia, eŋetine mane Kristo baŋ sariake. Eŋe sariake naso yewao kine kine korop baŋ oŋo ŋedan wareake.”
Raki so, Yesuŋo olatke, “Na mo iwa! Noŋo don iwa golat maile.”

Yale olale okoraki so dokoine eaka zinge sarikoi paki, so maratkau ŋerep don olatke, ea wane zok oŋaene qaeke. Ŋo siluŋ eŋano ŋine maneŋo olale mi rake, “Ge onokaka makenane?” Me qesonka rakoi, “Ge onoka wane eŋerop don aumamik?”
Paki so ŋerep eŋe doku laseine yewa qeliŋgi metkiso zinge matko ari ŋei ŋerep edane rake,
“Ŋine sari ŋei mane kau, eŋe sogino kine kine okangole makole, yewa korop ra wakone nolat waremaike, Anutu eŋe sogino ra rokop donine ŋei mane sariakane rake, ea wane wele, eŋe Mesia mane?”
Yale ra edangi so eŋe mat qelige so, Yesu wano sarikoi.
Naso yewaoka dokoine eŋe Yesu taleka rakoi, “Kito ŋebo ŋebon, ge siluŋ ŋara mane nenom!”
Yesuŋo mainge edange, “Na ŋara natne nekalane ma gemaile, ŋine ea wane kine mi detmami.”
Raki so dokoine eŋe edomka auye qeson nagu rakoi, “Ŋei maneŋo ŋara kaki mane mo masari manimi mane?”
Yesuŋo dokoine edane rake “Naŋane ŋara yemo talenange, eŋane aŋaine tewekkale so urata makalane ninge yewa ma warewe qoeake.

Ŋidom iwa yale ra okanmami, ‘Meso etke so etke (4) qoeki, ŋara wele wakoniake.’ Noŋo ŋidanbe, ŋine kaŋ qae more deŋine pore eu kauluke kau, ŋara wele mo menaŋmaike paki, qesoŋgenane naso mo bomilemaike!

Ŋei ŋara wele lokakeake, eŋe ea wane lewine mayake, Paki mo ŋara wele peike magukeake, yewa mo gege togon wane biŋek okaniake. Yale okangi, ŋeiwa ŋara metke, eŋe so ŋara wele lokake magukke ere weneŋ orodoŋ oi bakom kitokeik.
Yale okangi mo, don iwa yale welekatne okaniake, ‘Ŋei maneŋo ŋara qe met okan okanmaike, ŋo maneŋo ŋara wele lokak okanmaike.’
Na euo ŋine ŋara wele lokakkei wane taleŋunbe arikoi, ŋara yewa ŋidom waetnane urataine mi makoi. Ŋei natne edo ŋara urataine yewa makoi ŋo ŋine yemo yaup eŋano ŋine ŋara wele lokak okanmami.”
Mat yewa ŋine Samaria ŋei ŋerep loutneŋo ŋerep wane donkisi dere more Yesu malip kakoi, onoka wane ŋerep eŋe edane rake, “Eŋe tanik kine kine mo sogino okane gekole, eamo korop nolat waremaike.”
Eso Samaria ŋei ŋerep eŋe mo ea Yesu wano sari more eŋerop geakane ma walukkakoi. Paki so Yesuŋo eŋerop mat yewao kaiwe etke geke.
Paki so Yesu eŋe wet menaŋ don edangane ŋei ŋerep loutneŋo dere malipkakoi.

Paki ŋerep olale rakoi, “Ŋene ukude malip kamaine, ea mo goŋoka don kisiine ra ŋedanine ea wane ka mida, yemo ŋene ŋedom ketzeŋo donine detkamaine, so ŋene iwa yale weneŋ detlukmaine, eŋe welekatne kepe baŋem ŋei ŋerep korop ma menaŋon wareake.”
Yesuŋo Yuda Ware Ware Mane Wane Gipole Ma Menaŋkake
Kaiwe etke yewa geki qoeki ea wane ŋadino Yesuŋo ea qelige Galili kepeo arike.
Yesu oŋom iwa yale rake, “Propet mane eŋe eŋine kepe matino geki ewine mi kitokei.”

Yesu Galili kepeo ari lotkeke naso yewao ŋei ŋerep eŋe kima okankakoi, onoka wane eŋe Waomŋo Loloŋonge, ea wane peadaino zonom mama nasoo peada mesikei wane Yerusalem matko, masi so urata kine kine zonom mama peada nasoo maki kakoi, ea wane yale okankakoi.
Eso Yesu eŋe mo koso zinge Kana matko Galili kepeo alakan dokuŋo raki qeinge wain okange yewa arike. Ware ware mane yewa geke, eŋane gipole zoma suaine okankaki, Kaperneam matko pake.
Ware ware eŋe detki Yesu mo Yuda kepeo ŋine Galili kepeo arike. Eso eŋe moya Yesu wano ariki paki, Kaperneam matko weneŋ ari, gipole ma menaŋ kayakane olatke. Gipole mo seukeakane okane pake.
Yesuŋo olale rake, “Ŋine masi suaine so urata kuneŋineka kau paki, malip nangei, ŋo mi kau paki, yemo mi malip nanbi rap, ŋo yaup yemo midakaka.”
Ware wareŋo mainge olatke, “Suaine, narop esat arite, medepne mo seukeakane okanmaike.”
Yesuŋo olale rake, “Arinom, medep ŋone baŋ wisikaeyake!” Paki so ŋei eŋe Yesu wane don dere malipka so arike.
Matko ariakane ariki qelit medewekoune mo numao don ma ari olale rakoi, “Medepŋone mo maine okane gemaike!”
Eŋe qesononge, “Ma nasoo gipone zoma qeliŋkeke?” Eso eŋe rakoi, “Yemo wan kilok yatne kepe zingeki, eao zoma qeliŋkeke.”
Yale rau magaine eŋe detke nasomde yewaoka Yesuŋo olale rake, “Geŋane giponŋone baŋ wie geake.” Paki so eŋine so magukoune eŋe korop Yesu malipka warekoi.
Iwa yemo urata togogole Yesu ŋo Yuda kepeo ŋine Galili kepeo sariki paki maki atak etke okange.
